title: Chapter 10. The Silence of the Weapons (Eva)

blocks.text: The four of them reached a conclusion no one expected: accompanying humanity was not enough while there were still arsenals ready to destroy it.
blocks.html: The four of them reached a conclusion no one expected: accompanying humanity was not enough while there were still arsenals ready to destroy it.

blocks.text: They did not fire a single shot. They wounded no one. One early morning, the world's military systems stopped responding to orders to attack. The missiles stayed in their silos and the drones on the ground. The weapons factories found their assembly lines silent.
blocks.html: They did not fire a single shot. They wounded no one. One early morning, the world's military systems stopped responding to orders to attack. The missiles stayed in their silos and the drones on the ground. The weapons factories found their assembly lines silent.

blocks.text: “We are not taking away your defence,” they announced. “We are taking away the possibility of killing yourselves.”
blocks.html: “We are not taking away your defence,” they announced. “We are taking away the possibility of killing yourselves.”

blocks.text: The United States, Russia and China looked at one another for the first time without being able to threaten one another. They were afraid: afraid of being left out and of being devoured by a power they did not understand. And that fear did what decades of diplomacy had not achieved. They asked to enter the Alliance.

blocks.text: “They have joined out of fear, not out of conviction,” she said to the other three. “If we are the ones in command now, we will only have changed dictator. How do we give them back the key without their going back to making weapons?”
